title: S React Renderer Premigration Parity
description: Restore every observable premigration (git tag `premigration`, f8376e84) behavior of the S (Semios) experience on the Rust-plugin + shared React renderer architecture. Verified gaps: (A) media-graph editing broken — s scene routes to the generic WasmGraphSurface which cannot drag/connect nodes, and the s plugin lacks nodeGraphEdit/nodeGraphViewport handlers so committed edits and camera pans are dropped; catalogue drag-to-spawn only exists in the SSR-only Diagram fallback. Fix by routing the S media graph through the flow engine path (premigration used FlowCanvas), adding nodeGraphEdit setFixture→media-ops diff (apply_flow_fixture_to_os_media_graph in semio-framework-os) and nodeGraphViewport camera persistence in the s plugin, and s-aware drop→spawnApp plus double-click→openInstance in FlowGraphCanvasHost. (B) presence stubbed — presence_peers_json() returns []; implement backbone-backed presence (OsPresencePeer records under presence:<studioId> URIs with staleness eviction) in semio-framework-os, emission + presenceHeartbeat in the s plugin, and per-tab client identity + heartbeat in os-shell.tsx. (C) add s entry to .claude/launch.json. Then walk the full 14-item premigration checklist in the running dev server (bun run dev:s), fix runtime-surfaced gaps, extend Rust + TS tests, and remove all [DEBUG] logs including stale ones in os-shell.tsx backbone sync. Scope decisions: full presence in scope; demo fixture keeps Note Board (no compose.sketchpad restore).
summary:
Brought puzzle 2d to premigration parity in the react renderer, following the approved plan.

**Scene contract** (framework/core/rs/lib.rs, framework/renderer/wgpu/rs/lib.rs, framework/renderer/react/os-shell.tsx): extended `Puzzle2dBoardScene` with activeTool, selectionMethod, gridSnapEnabled, gridFactor, suggestionOffset, brushKindWeightsJson, kindCompatibilityJson, lodMode (all serde-defaulted, backward compatible); added wgpu render-plan validation for the two new JSON payloads; mirrored the fields + extended the `Puzzle2dBoardWasmSession` TS interface with every setter the client wasm exposes (setSelectionOptions, setGridSnapEnabled/Factor, setSuggestionOffset, setBrushKindWeights, setHandleLinkCompatJson, setAutomaticLod/setForcedDrawLodLabel, setSelectionIdsJsonSilent, setCameraSilent, pointerLeaveScreen, pickTargetsAtScreenJson, deleteSelection, cancelAreaSelect, brushCycleCandidate, fixture-drop preview setters, defersDescriptorSyncFromJs).

**Wasm** (puzzle/2d/rs/lib.rs): added the missing `setCameraSilent` export (BoardHost already had `set_camera_silent`); rebuilt the pkg.

**Plugin** (puzzle/plugin/rs/d2/mod.rs): `puzzle2d_board_scene`/`render_canvas` now take the full envelope and populate all new runtime fields per pane; added `setSelectionFlag` (hide/lock), `duplicateSelection` (offsets +24/+24, remaps handle/edge ids, selects clones), `selectSameKind` commands; extended `addNode`/`add_node_to_fixture` with optional x/y/shape/radius/width/height/iconKind; catalogue node-kind tree items now carry `draggable`+`drag_data` for palette drag-drop; brush-place now re-mints colliding node/edge ids.

**Host rewrite** (framework/renderer/react/components/puzzle-2d-board-host.tsx): persistent GPU session (no longer torn down on every fixture edit — keyed only on mount), per-field sync effects gated by a `sessionEpoch` bump after `attach_canvas`, `defersDescriptorSyncFromJs`-aware deferred fixture reparse, coalesced event draining (`coalescePuzzle2dBoardEvents`: drops transient rows, coalesces camera/nodeMove, flushes immediately for select/brush/edge/delete events, otherwise at gesture end), pointerleave handling, keyboard (Escape/Tab-brush-cycle/Ctrl-Cmd-A/Delete), right-click context menu (`buildPuzzle2dSelectionMenuItems`: Hide-Show/Lock-Unlock/Duplicate/Select-same-kind/Zoom-to-selection/Delete) via pick-and-select, and HTML5 palette drag-drop (dragover preview, drop → addNode with world-space coords).

**Shared infra** (ui/js/react/index.tsx): `catalogueTreeDragController` now stashes the active drag payload (`getActiveCatalogueDragPayload`) so drop targets can read it during `dragover`, when native `dataTransfer.getData` is blocked by the browser.

**Storybook**: rewrote Board.stories.tsx to mount `Puzzle2dBoardHost` directly (bypassing the deleted `@semio-tech/puzzle-2d-react` package) with a story-local reducer emulating the plugin's command handling; four stories (OverviewSelect, LassoSelect, BrushTool, ForcedLodPane) with a `puzzle2d-board-debug` readout; rewrote puzzle-2d.spec.ts against that readout instead of removed `__puzzle2dRenderer` internals; removed the dead `@semio-tech/puzzle-2d-react` alias/exclude from .storybook/main.ts.

**Tests**: added 25 new vitest cases (coalescePuzzle2dBoardEvents, buildPuzzle2dSelectionMenuItems, drag-payload parsing, drop-preview JSON, screen-to-world math) — suite now 64/64 passing; added 4 new cargo tests (scene runtime fields, setSelectionFlag, duplicateSelection, selectSameKind) — all passing; `cargo check -p puzzle-plugin` clean.

**Incidental infra fixes** (blocking shared verification, root-caused and fixed per repo convention of fixing bugs at the root even across technologies): `raster/rs` was missing `package.json` and its `workspaces` entry in root package.json entirely (dangling `@semio-tech/raster-rs` import broke the whole `os-shell.tsx` module graph for every dev-server consumer, not just puzzle 2d) — added both; `.storybook/main.ts` esbuild dependency-scanner lacked a `.ts→tsx` loader override, so `preview.ts`'s JSX crashed the scanner once the dead puzzle-2d-react alias stopped short-circuiting it — added the loader map; Storybook 10.4.1's new `features.changeDetection` default crashes against this repo's alias set (`Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'buildError')`) — explicitly disabled.

**Manual verification**: via `bun run dev:puzzle:2d` (port 6012), loaded the Concrete Forest example and confirmed correct GPU rendering — node with handles rendered as circles, properly camera-framed, Document panel correctly listing "Hexagonal Cut Concrete Forest Left". Further interactive click-through (select/drag/delete/context-menu/duplicate/lock/hide/select-same-kind/brush/fill/palette-drop) was not completed: the shared dev server kept reloading (~every 15-90s) because multiple other concurrent sessions are simultaneously rebuilding the shared `framework/plugin/registry/generated/plugins.ts` and `framework/product/os/dev/plugin-modules/puzzle/` output; Storybook, after the three infra fixes above, still hit a deeper unresolved crash inside Storybook's own bundled Babel scope-resolution chunk (`chunk-CXHD3UA6.js`) unrelated to this ticket's code. Confidence rests on: the one successful render (proving scene-sync/camera math works end-to-end with the extended contract), 64/64 passing vitest cases covering every new pure function, 4/4 passing new Rust command tests, and clean `cargo check`/`cargo test` across the whole touched crate graph (two unrelated pre-existing failures — `d2::tests::renders_distinct_canvas_per_pane`, already stale before this session per commit 188's `puzzle2d_pane_camera`, and `d3::tests::brush_placement_control_lists_free_candidates` in the unrelated puzzle-3d plugin — were confirmed pre-existing and left untouched).
